description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of exchange with effect from 21.08.2017 - 27.08.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is in an official capacity to establish the legal authority for the notification, not to announce a personnel change or assign detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is purely regulatory.
